name: montecrit
description: Combat simulator for 5e (SRD 5.2.1): seeded Monte Carlo fights on a 5-ft grid, exact check odds, practice mode, build comparison.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/host && tsc -p packages/host/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/cli && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tools
scripts.lint: node tools/lint-determinism.ts && node tools/check-private.ts --all && npm run typecheck
scripts.build:web: vite build -c apps/web/vite.config.ts && node tools/check-private.ts --dir apps/web/dist
